notes.title: Update 1.0.4 (MZ Update)
notes.content:
- The game now runs on RPG maker MZ and no longer on MV

- Dimensions are now 1280 x 720

- All images are now set to the size 1280 x 720

- New icon for Angela with a new design

Whaoo it's only been 1 year since the last update how fast time goes by and how many new things are in this little update. The Big Adventure will now run on RPG maker MZ with it's screen size now 1280 x 720 for an optimal experience, beware not all images are great in these proportions.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Balanced boss fight Amber from 500 HP will now have 850 HP to give an excellent boss fight.

- Fixed corridor in Lucifer castle.

- New special weapons added to Lilith store.

The goddess Amber has increased her HP to be even more powerful like the other bosses. Fixed a small part in the corridor in Lucifer's Castle. New special weapons Lucifer's chains powerful weapon but also heavy if not handled by his own creator and poison gun with poisonous bullets. This will be the last update of this year because in 2025 I will start the development of part 2 or the final part, I wish everyone a Merry Christmas and hopefully a good year.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug in Runia stomach where there were invisible barriers.

- Fixed some pronouns that were incorrect in some dialogues.

- Minor improvements to some dialogues.

Hello we have fixed several things including a bug in Runia's body but the biggest error that was not fixed were the incorrect pronouns e.g. sometimes Mia was referred to as a male with the pronoun He which has now been fixed as on all dialogues.
